## India: DPDPA Takes Effect & Faces Scrutiny

India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), 2023, has officially come into force following the finalization and activation of the DPDP Rules, 2025. This marks a significant milestone, ushering in a new era for data privacy enforcement across the country and requiring all data fiduciaries to align their practices with the new framework. Legal and consulting firms are actively publishing guidance on compliance fundamentals and operational impacts for businesses.

The Supreme Court has issued notice to the Centre in response to petitions filed by news publishers and media associations challenging the constitutionality of the DPDPA. Concerns have been raised by journalists and civil society groups that certain provisions of the Act could impede press freedom and journalistic activities. Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw has reiterated the government's stance that the DPDPA does not infringe on media freedom and expressed openness to suggestions from the industry.
